title: The glass look, and your own colours
detail: A new design for the whole window, a light theme for the day, and Settings > Personalisation for the accent, the background and the glass.

title: Steadier controller voices
detail: The phrase intonation no longer roughens the voice: asked to change nothing, it now gives back exactly what the synthesiser said.

title: Baggage, stairs and doors that fit
detail: GSX's loader, handler and carts work as one baggage flow, each door gets its own staircase at its sill, and the traffic rests on all its wheels.

title: The ramp in order
detail: Each door at its own height, the belt loader docked by its belt, and each service vehicle on ground of its own.

title: Smooth traffic
detail: The other aeroplanes are drawn every frame: a taxi, a takeoff and a landing instead of jumps, on the simulator's own ground.

title: Ground vehicles and GSX Pro
detail: Vehicles at the door they serve, GSX Pro's own vehicles when you have it, and engines and lights on the traffic run the way an airline runs them.

title: Ground handling for the traffic
detail: Doors, holds and turnarounds for the AI aeroplanes, detailed models near you in their airline's own livery.

title: A better tower
detail: Clearance requests answered by the tower, complete readbacks, hold-shorts that name their runway, and one language per frequency.
